speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child suffering from fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain for three weeks; tell me, how would you describe the pain in your legs?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: The leg pain is severe enough to wake you from sleep; is the pain located in the bones themselves or just the muscles? Please also tell me if you have noticed any specific spots on your skin or if you have had any recent infections.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The symptoms of fever, severe bone pain, easy bruising, and fatigue are highly characteristic of leukemia, not cellulitis. I need to confirm your blood counts and bone marrow status immediately. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential, PT, PTT, Urinalysis. REQUEST IMAGES: None at this time.
